lag.evidence_source: [/page/4/Figure/11] Fig. 1. Reciprocal model between smoking and urgency at waves 4-8. Note: Horizontal arrows connecting urgency at each wave with urgency at the subsequent waves and smoke at each wave with smoke at the subsequent waves represent Step 1 of the model, the autoregressive pathways; text above these arrows represents the estimate of the autoregressive effects. Diagonal arrows connecting urgency at each wave with smoke at the subsequent wave represent the pathways added at Step 2 of the model; text above these arrows represents the estimate of the pathway from urgency to ever smoking. Diagonal arrows connecting smoke at each wave with urgency at the subsequent wave represent the pathways added at Step 3 of the model; text above these arrows represents the estimate of the pathway from ever smoking to urgency. Solid lines indicate significant effects while dashed lines indicate non-significant effects. * p < 0.05; ** p < 0.01.
